tasks.short: Advise on radiation incidents and assist civil defence planning.

steps.what: Read actual incident facts and approved radiation-response procedures
Determine appropriate technical advice and limits for the actual radiation situation
Write and check final procedural advice and designated authority recipient
outputs: checked final radiation advice and recipient

steps.what: Send the final procedural advice to the designated public authority
inputs: checked final radiation advice and recipient

steps.what: Discuss actual response procedures and civil defence planning with authorities
inputs: checked final radiation advice and recipient

steps.what: Record and check actual planning decisions and unresolved questions

tasks.design: Configure native {DOCS} approved-procedure views and advice headings. Keep radiation judgement and actual authority discussions human; check the full final advice before external send and record planning outcomes only after discussion.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated approved-source lookup and advice layout.
tasks.enabler_now: Native revision views and document fields.
tasks.still_hard: Incomplete incident information and safety-critical interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: Give qualified advice appropriate to the actual radiation hazard.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated preparation; radiation and emergency authority unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native document revision views and headings can reduce retrieval and layout without selecting radiation-response actions.

assumptions: Boundary includes written advice, discussion and own planning record. Incident lead supplies actual location, time, radionuclide if known, measured quantities, units and uncertainties; procedure owner supplies approved version and scope. Physicist checks missing facts manually in s1 and selects advice in s2. Unknown hazards remain unknown; no generated response or automatic instruction.

Native first. Shares provisional for mixed written/oral planning, not a measured incident baseline. s3 reduces only repeated layout; normal technical checking remains within90 percent. Actual discussion30, decision record4, send1 and save1 unchanged. Advice gate assumes actual authority to give technical advice, not command incident actions.
unknowns: Current approved-source access and written/oral mix
research_questions: Can native views exclude superseded radiation procedures?

incremental.description: Maintain approved-source links and advice fields

approvals.approved_version: s3 complete checked final radiation advice and authority recipient
s6 complete checked actual planning record

tasks.short: Research environmental impacts of atomic-energy development for licensing.

steps.what: Verify actual development characteristics, environmental observations and applicable licensing criteria
Select research methods, exposure scenarios and justified modelling assumptions
Populate selected scenarios in validated environmental radiation modelling software
Judge environmental impact, model adequacy, uncertainty and licensing implications
Record and check actual research findings, assumptions and limitations
Save the final impact research record

tasks.design: Test native parameter imports and reusable scenario layouts in {OTHER} validated radiation-impact modelling software. Physicist chooses methods and assumptions, checks diagnostic adequacy and determines research conclusions; no licensing approval is automated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated model parameter population across selected scenarios.
tasks.enabler_now: Native validated imports and scenario structures.
tasks.still_hard: Model validity, uncertain releases and environmental exposure pathways.
tasks.human_edge: Judge whether the evidence supports the licensing-relevant conclusion.
tasks.altitude: Less scenario preparation; scientific and licensing authority unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: validated environmental radiation models may support parameter imports and scenario reuse; these features do not establish model validity or licensing qualifications.

assumptions: Boundary is physicist research through own findings record, not the regulator's licence decision. Design owner supplies actual facility characteristics and release assumptions; measurement producers supply actual observations, units, methods and uncertainties; licensing owner supplies criteria. Physicist verifies sources in s1, chooses scenario parameters in s2 and manually enters unsupported formats in s3. Missing facts require investigation.

Native first; only repeated parameter entry within provisional25 reduces30 percent. Existing runtime and configured imports earn zero saving; model creation or method breakthroughs not assumed. Evidence25, methods25, interpretation20, findings4 and save1 fully retained. Shares unmeasured.
unknowns: Actual validated-model import support and repeated entry burden
research_questions: Can native scenario reuse preserve parameter units, provenance and validation status?

incremental.description: Revalidate parameter mappings after source or model changes

approvals.approved_version: s5 complete checked final impact research record

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional scenario25 reduced30 percent saves7.5 minus1 upkeep=6.5. Half eligible repeated scenarios gives2.75; evidence25, methods25, interpretation20, findings4 and save1 unchanged.

steps.what: Read current scientific evidence, exposure assumptions and existing concentration criteria
Choose defensible exposure assumptions, protection objectives and calculation methods
Calculate specified concentration scenarios and sensitivity tables in validated analysis software
Judge uncertainty and select proposed permissible concentrations with explicit scientific rationale
Write and check the proposed standards record and limitations

tasks.design: Configure native repeat scenario and sensitivity-table layouts in {OTHER} validated analysis software. Physicist selects methodology, reviews uncertainty and proposes concentrations; the record remains a scientific proposal until the actual competent authority adopts it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated scenario population and sensitivity-table preparation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native validated analysis recipes and reusable parameter layouts.
tasks.still_hard: Defensible protection objectives and uncertain exposure assumptions.
tasks.human_edge: Decide which concentration proposal the evidence supports and qualify its scope.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated calculation preparation; no automatic standard-setting authority.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: validated analysis software can repeat specified scenarios and sensitivity tables without choosing permissible radioisotope concentrations.

assumptions: Boundary is development of proposed scientific criteria through own record, not legal adoption. Evidence owners supply actual radionuclide, medium, units, exposure pathway, parameter values, uncertainty and source references. Physicist verifies sources in s1, selects assumptions and methods in s2 and enters parameters in s3; unsupported values require manual resolution. No invented concentration limits.

Native first; provisional s3 reduction covers only repeated parameter/table preparation, never compute runtime. Already configured recipes yield zero. Reading30, methodology30, criteria judgement15, record4 and save1 retain full time. Shares unmeasured; no extra approval ceremony or automated external issuance.
unknowns: Current validated recipe support and actual repeated table preparation
research_questions: Can native recipes expose parameter revisions and preserve scientific uncertainty?
